blocks.zh: Section 1: Data Integrity Regulatory Trends / 資料完整性監管趨勢分析
blocks.en: Section 1: Data Integrity Regulatory Trends

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 FDA 警告信（Warning Letter）中資料完整性違規的歷史演變與統計趨勢，掌握自 2012 年以來的主要數據。
blocks.en: Understand the historical evolution and statistical trends of data integrity violations in FDA Warning Letters, and master the key figures since 2012.

blocks.zh: 區分 EU 不合規報告（Non-Compliance Report, NCR）中不同製造領域（生產系統、實驗室系統）的資料完整性缺陷類型。
blocks.en: Distinguish the types of data integrity deficiencies in EU Non-Compliance Reports (NCRs) across manufacturing areas (production systems and laboratory systems).

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Table 3.1.3-1🔍 所列出的十三類生產相關資料完整性違規類別，並能辨識其在無菌充填廠的實際對應情境。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the thirteen categories of production-related data integrity violations listed in Table 3.1.3-1🔍, and be able to recognize how they map to real situations in an aseptic filling facility.

blocks.zh: 掌握主要全球監管機構（FDA、MHRA、WHO、PIC/S）所發布的資料完整性指引文件，以及產業最佳實踐（PDA、ISPE、APIC）的核心架構。
blocks.en: Understand the data integrity guidance documents issued by the major global regulators (FDA, MHRA, WHO, PIC/S) and the core framework of industry best practices (PDA, ISPE, APIC).

blocks.zh: 本節結構 Section Structure
blocks.en: Section Structure

blocks.zh: Historical Perspective / 歷史演變
blocks.en: Historical Perspective

blocks.zh: 解析與應用（繁體中文）
blocks.en: Analysis and Application (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：GMP 資料完整性的歷史脈絡
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Historical Context of GMP Data Integrity

blocks.zh: 資料完整性（Data Integrity）並非新議題——FDA 自 1963 年制定 GMP 法規起，即隱含對記錄準確性的要求。1978 年 21 CFR Part 211 正式建立生產記錄的法規框架。
blocks.en: Data integrity (DI) is not a new issue. Since FDA first established GMP regulations in 1963, accuracy of records has been implicitly required, and 21 CFR Part 211 in 1978 formally set out the regulatory framework for production records.

blocks.zh: 關鍵里程碑：
blocks.en: Key milestones:

blocks.zh: 1963 年：FDA GMP 法規首次頒布
blocks.en: 1963: FDA GMP regulations first issued

blocks.zh: 1978 年：21 CFR Part 211（現行 GMP）修訂
blocks.en: 1978: 21 CFR Part 211 (current GMP) revised

blocks.zh: 1990 年：仿製藥醜聞後設立上市前查廠制度
blocks.en: 1990: Pre-approval inspection program established after the generic drug scandal

blocks.zh: 1997 年：21 CFR Part 11（電子記錄與簽章）頒布
blocks.en: 1997: 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic records and signatures) issued

blocks.zh: 2007 年以後：全球供應鏈擴張帶動 DI 缺陷激增
blocks.en: After 2007: Expansion of the global supply chain drives a surge in DI deficiencies

blocks.zh: 比喻：「審計人員的進化」
blocks.en: Analogy: "The Evolution of the Auditor"

blocks.zh: 想像銀行查帳員的工作演變：早期只查帳面數字，後來開始比對流水帳、查原始憑證、調監視錄影。FDA 查廠員的 DI 調查技巧同樣經歷這段演化——從單純翻閱批次記錄，到使用數位鑑識（forensic techniques）分析 audit trail 時間戳記。
blocks.en: Think of how a bank examiner's work has evolved: at first they only checked the figures in the books, then began cross-checking the journals, verifying original vouchers, and reviewing surveillance video. FDA investigators' DI inspection techniques have gone through the same evolution, from simply reading through batch records to using forensic techniques to analyze audit trail timestamps.

blocks.zh: 監管警示：「仿製藥醜聞」的深遠影響
blocks.en: Regulatory Alert: The Far-Reaching Impact of the "Generic Drug Scandal"

blocks.zh: 1980–1990 年代的美國仿製藥醜聞（generic drug scandal）是 DI 史上最重大的分水嶺事件。多家藥廠被發現大規模偽造批次記錄、在新藥申請（ANDA）中提交假數據。
blocks.en: The U.S. generic drug scandal of the 1980s-1990s was the most significant turning point in DI history. Several firms were found to have falsified batch records on a large scale and submitted false data in abbreviated new drug applications (ANDAs).

blocks.zh: 後果包括：刑事起訴（包含 FDA 內部人員）、業界改革、以及催生了沿用至今的上市前查廠制度（Pre-Approval Inspection Program）。
blocks.en: The consequences included criminal prosecutions (including FDA personnel), industry reform, and the creation of the Pre-Approval Inspection Program that remains in use today.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 的重要性
blocks.en: Why 21 CFR Part 11 Matters

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 第11部分（21 CFR Part 11）是美國對電子記錄與電子簽章的專屬法規，1997 年頒布，規範：
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 11 is the U.S. regulation specific to electronic records and electronic signatures. Issued in 1997, it governs:

blocks.zh: 電子記錄的完整性控制
blocks.en: Integrity controls for electronic records

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）要求
blocks.en: Audit trail requirements

blocks.zh: 電子簽章的身分驗證
blocks.en: Identity verification for electronic signatures

blocks.zh: 系統存取控制與安全性
blocks.en: System access control and security

blocks.zh: 對應的歐盟框架為歐盟 GMP 附件11（EU GMP Annex 11）。
blocks.en: The corresponding EU framework is EU GMP Annex 11.

blocks.zh: 趨勢警示：2012 年後 DI 問題激增
blocks.en: Trend Alert: DI Problems Surge After 2012

blocks.zh: 2012 年是現代 DI 執法的轉折點。FDA、EMA、MHRA（英國藥品與健保產品管理局）、WHO 同步加強對國際廠商的查廠力道，印度與中國製造商首當其衝。
blocks.en: 2012 was the turning point for modern DI enforcement. FDA, EMA, MHRA (the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency), and WHO simultaneously stepped up inspections of international manufacturers, with manufacturers in India and China bearing the brunt.

blocks.zh: FDA 已針對 20 個以上國家的廠商發出超過 200 封包含 DI 引述的警告信（Warning Letter）。
blocks.en: FDA has issued more than 200 Warning Letters citing DI to firms in more than 20 countries.

blocks.zh: 理解確認
blocks.en: Check Your Understanding

blocks.zh: 思考問題：為什麼全球製藥供應鏈的擴張會加劇 DI 問題？遠端製造廠相較於本地廠有哪些更高的 DI 風險因素？
blocks.en: Question to consider: Why does the expansion of the global pharmaceutical supply chain aggravate DI problems? What higher DI risk factors do remote manufacturing sites have compared with local sites?

blocks.zh: U.S. FDA Warning Letters / FDA 警告信分析
blocks.en: U.S. FDA Warning Letters: Analysis

blocks.zh: 數據解讀：53% 的警告信與 DI 相關
blocks.en: Interpreting the Data: 53% of Warning Letters Are DI-Related

blocks.zh: 這是本節最震撼的統計：在 2012–2019 年間，FDA 發出的 393 封警告信（Warning Letter）中，超過一半（212 封，53%）包含資料完整性（Data Integrity）引述。
blocks.en: This is the most striking statistic in this section: of the 393 Warning Letters (WLs) FDA issued between 2012 and 2019, more than half (212, or 53%) included data integrity (DI) citations.

blocks.zh: 這意味著 DI 已是 FDA 查廠最常見的違規類別——不是特例，是常態。
blocks.en: This means DI is the most common category of violation in FDA inspections: not the exception, but the norm.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數據速查
blocks.en: Key Data at a Glance

blocks.zh:
總 WL 數：393 封（2012/02 – 2019/08）
含 DI 引述：212 封（53%）
  其中生產相關：96 封（45%）
  其中實驗室 / 品保相關：116 封（55%）

生產相關 96 封分佈：
  API 廠：35 封（36%）
  FDF 廠：58 封（60%）
  API + FDF 廠：3 封（3%）

地理分佈前三名：
  印度：37 封
  中國：21 封
  美國：13 封
blocks.en:
Total WLs: 393 (2012/02 - 2019/08)
With DI citations: 212 (53%)
  Production-related: 96 (45%)
  Laboratory / QA-related: 116 (55%)

Distribution of the 96 production-related WLs:
  API sites: 35 (36%)
  FDF sites: 58 (60%)
  API + FDF sites: 3 (3%)

Top three countries:
  India: 37
  China: 21
  United States: 13

blocks.zh: 比喻：PLC vs 手寫批次記錄的矛盾
blocks.en: Analogy: PLC vs. Handwritten Batch Records

blocks.zh: 想像工廠的自動溫控系統顯示製程溫度超標，但操作員在批次記錄上手寫「溫度正常」——這就是 PLC 電子數據與紙本批次記錄不一致（HMI vs 批次記錄差異）的典型情境。
blocks.en: Imagine a factory's automatic temperature control system showing that the process temperature is out of limits, while the operator handwrites "temperature normal" on the batch record. This is the classic case of PLC electronic data being inconsistent with the paper batch record (a discrepancy between the HMI and the batch record).

blocks.zh: 對無菌充填廠（CDMO）而言，這種情境等同於自動壓縮機的 PLC 顯示製程參數超標，但批次記錄顯示一切正常——兩者不一致即是 DI 紅旗。
blocks.en: For an aseptic filling facility (CDMO), this situation is equivalent to an automated compressor's PLC showing process parameters out of limits while the batch record shows everything normal. Any such inconsistency is a DI red flag.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用警示：臺灣廠商同樣在列
blocks.en: CDMO Application Alert: Taiwan Firms Are on the List Too

blocks.zh: 圖表顯示台灣（Taiwan）在此期間收到 2 封生產相關 DI 警告信。這提醒本地 CDMO 業者：DI 問題並非只發生於低成本國家，所有出口美國市場的廠商均受同等監管標準。
blocks.en: The chart shows that Taiwan received 2 production-related DI Warning Letters during this period. This is a reminder to local CDMOs that DI problems do not occur only in low-cost countries; all firms exporting to the U.S. market are held to the same regulatory standards.

blocks.zh: Import Alert（進口警示）是比 Warning Letter 更嚴重的後果，可能導致產品無法進入美國市場。
blocks.en: An Import Alert is a more serious consequence than a Warning Letter and can prevent products from entering the U.S. market.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用場景
blocks.en: Practical CDMO Application Scenarios

blocks.zh: 在您的無菌充填設施中，哪些系統存在「電子數據 vs 手動記錄」的雙軌並存情況？例如：
blocks.en: In your aseptic filling facility, which systems run "electronic data vs. manual records" in parallel? For example:

blocks.zh: 凍乾機（Lyophilizer）的 PLC 溫度曲線 vs 操作員記錄的批次記錄
blocks.en: Lyophilizer PLC temperature profile vs. the batch record completed by the operator

blocks.zh: 自動稱重系統數據 vs 手寫配製記錄
blocks.en: Automated weighing system data vs. handwritten compounding records

blocks.zh: 環境監測系統（EM）電子讀數 vs 人工抄寫的 EM 報告
blocks.en: Electronic readings from the environmental monitoring (EM) system vs. manually transcribed EM reports

blocks.zh: 上述任一不一致均可能成為 FDA 查廠的 DI 引述依據。
blocks.en: Any of the above inconsistencies could become the basis for an FDA DI citation.

blocks.zh: EU Non-Compliance Reports / 歐盟不合規報告分析
blocks.en: EU Non-Compliance Reports: Analysis

blocks.zh: 什麼是 EU NCR（不合規報告）？
blocks.en: What Is an EU NCR (Non-Compliance Report)?

blocks.zh: EU Non-Compliance Report（NCR，不合規報告）是歐盟藥品監管機構（EMA 成員國）對查廠發現嚴重 GMP 缺陷時所發布的正式文件。
blocks.en: An EU Non-Compliance Report (NCR) is a formal document issued by EU medicines regulatory authorities (EMA member states) when an inspection finds serious GMP deficiencies.

blocks.zh: 與 FDA 警告信（Warning Letter）性質相似，但由歐盟各成員國的主管機關（如英國 MHRA、法國 ANSM、德國 BFARM）發出，結果可能包括：暫停生產許可、歐盟 GDP 認證吊銷等。
blocks.en: Similar in nature to an FDA Warning Letter, it is issued by the competent authorities of EU member states (such as MHRA in the UK, ANSM in France, and BfArM in Germany), and the outcome may include suspension of the manufacturing authorization or revocation of the EU GMP certificate.

blocks.zh: EU NCR DI 數據速查
blocks.en: EU NCR DI Data at a Glance

blocks.zh:
總 NCR 數：163 件（2012/01 – 2018/08）
含 DI 引述：82 件（50%）

82 件 DI NCR 分佈：
  生產系統造假問題：46%
  實驗室系統造假問題：22%
  兩者均涉及：32%

地理前兩名：
  印度：49%
  中國：23%
blocks.en:
Total NCRs: 163 (2012/01 - 2018/08)
With DI citations: 82 (50%)

Distribution of the 82 DI NCRs:
  Falsification in production systems: 46%
  Falsification in laboratory systems: 22%
  Both involved: 32%

Top two countries:
  India: 49%
  China: 23%

blocks.zh: 比喻：FDA vs EU 查廠結果的一致性
blocks.en: Analogy: Consistency Between FDA and EU Inspection Results

blocks.zh: FDA（美國）和 EU（歐盟）的 DI 數據驚人地一致：兩者約一半的查廠不合規報告都源於資料完整性問題。這就像兩位來自不同國家的稽核員，同時發現了同一家工廠的相同問題——說明這是系統性、跨地域的產業缺陷，而非地區性問題。
blocks.en: The DI data from FDA (U.S.) and the EU are strikingly consistent: in both, about half of the non-compliance reports stem from data integrity problems. It is like two auditors from different countries independently finding the same problem at the same plant, which shows this is a systemic, cross-regional industry deficiency rather than a regional one.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：生產系統 vs 實驗室系統
blocks.en: Key Point: Production Systems vs. Laboratory Systems

blocks.zh: EU NCR 數據顯示，生產系統（Production System）是 DI 造假的主要場域（46%），其次是生產+實驗室雙系統（32%）。
blocks.en: EU NCR data show that production systems are the main area of DI falsification (46%), followed by cases involving both production and laboratory systems (32%).

blocks.zh: 這對無菌充填 CDMO 的意義：生產記錄（批次記錄、清潔記錄、設備使用日誌）和實驗室數據（QC 測試結果、OOS 調查）都是 DI 高風險區域，必須雙線管控。
blocks.en: What this means for an aseptic filling CDMO: production records (batch records, cleaning records, equipment usage logs) and laboratory data (QC test results, OOS investigations) are both high-risk DI areas and must be controlled on both fronts.

blocks.zh: EU NCR 與 FDA Warning Letter 在 DI 統計上均顯示約 50% 的不合規報告涉及 DI 問題。您認為這個趨勢在未來5年是否會改善？哪些技術或管理措施可能帶來改變？
blocks.en: Both EU NCRs and FDA Warning Letters show that about 50% of non-compliance reports involve DI problems. Do you think this trend will improve over the next five years? Which technologies or management measures could bring about change?

blocks.zh: Production-Related DI Trends by Category / 生產相關 DI 缺陷類別分析
blocks.en: Production-Related DI Trends by Category

blocks.zh: 四大主題架構
blocks.en: The Four Major Themes

blocks.zh: 所有 DI 生產違規可歸納為四個根本主題：
blocks.en: All DI production violations can be grouped into four fundamental themes:

blocks.zh: 文件紀錄實踐不良（Poor Documentation Practices）
blocks.en: Poor documentation practices

blocks.zh: 數據審查不足（Insufficient Data Review）
blocks.en: Insufficient data review

blocks.zh: 監管監督不力（Ineffective Oversight）
blocks.en: Ineffective oversight

blocks.zh: 系統控制失效（Ineffective System Control）
blocks.en: Ineffective system control

blocks.zh: 13 個具體類別是這四大主題的細化展開，方便查廠員和業者進行系統性分類。
blocks.en: The 13 specific categories are a detailed breakdown of these four themes, allowing inspectors and industry to classify issues systematically.

blocks.zh: 高風險類別警示：對無菌充填廠最相關的項目
blocks.en: High-Risk Category Alert: The Items Most Relevant to Aseptic Filling Facilities

blocks.zh: 以下幾個類別對無菌充填 CDMO 特別高風險：
blocks.en: The following categories are particularly high-risk for an aseptic filling CDMO:

blocks.zh: 資料造假（False Entries）：手套完整性測試（glove integrity testing）記錄造假，在無菌充填操作中尤其嚴重
blocks.en: False entries: falsified glove integrity testing records are especially serious in aseptic filling operations

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）停用：非活性粒子監測系統的電子稽核軌跡被關閉
blocks.en: Audit trail disabled: the electronic audit trail of a non-viable particle monitoring system was turned off

blocks.zh: 數據刪除（Data Deleted）：媒體充填（media fill）數據、滅菌器數據、過濾器完整性測試結果消失
blocks.en: Data deleted: media fill data, sterilizer data, and filter integrity test results disappear

blocks.zh: 回溯日期（Backdating）：批次記錄預先簽署或事後回溯填寫
blocks.en: Backdating: batch records are signed in advance or filled in retrospectively

blocks.zh: 比喻：「躲避查廠」的嚴重後果
blocks.en: Analogy: The Serious Consequences of "Evading Inspection"

blocks.zh: 表中「拒絕 / 阻礙稽查（Delay/Deny/Limit/Refuse Inspection）」類別包含一個極端案例：廠商在 FDA 查廠時傾倒無標籤小瓶（dumping unlabeled vials）。
blocks.en: The "Delay/Deny/Limit/Refuse Inspection" category in the table includes an extreme case: a firm dumping unlabeled vials during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 這就像被稅務局查帳時把帳本丟進碎紙機——不只是 DI 問題，而是直接觸犯刑法（obstruction of justice）。此類行為通常導致最嚴厲的監管行動。
blocks.en: This is like throwing your account books into a shredder during a tax audit: it is not only a DI problem but a direct violation of criminal law (obstruction of justice). Such conduct usually leads to the most severe regulatory action.

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）的監管意義
blocks.en: The Regulatory Significance of the Audit Trail

blocks.zh: Audit Trail（稽核軌跡）是電子系統中記錄「誰、在何時、做了什麼變更」的自動機制。
blocks.en: An audit trail is an automated mechanism in electronic systems that records "who made what change, and when."

blocks.zh: 符合要求的稽核軌跡必須：
blocks.en: A compliant audit trail must:

blocks.zh: 自動產生，無法被輕易關閉或刪除
blocks.en: Be generated automatically and not be easily disabled or deleted

blocks.zh: 記錄使用者 ID、時間戳記（date/time stamp）、動作類型
blocks.en: Record the user ID, date/time stamp, and type of action

blocks.zh: 涵蓋所有 GMP 相關電子記錄的建立、修改、刪除
blocks.en: Cover the creation, modification, and deletion of all GMP-relevant electronic records

blocks.zh: 定期由品保人員審查（Audit Trail Review）
blocks.en: Be reviewed regularly by QA personnel (audit trail review)

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 第11部分（21 CFR Part 11）和歐盟 GMP 附件11（EU GMP Annex 11）均對此有明確要求。
blocks.en: Both 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11 contain explicit requirements on this.

blocks.zh: 對照 Table 3.1.3-1🔍，請評估您廠中以下場景的 DI 風險：
blocks.en: With reference to Table 3.1.3-1🔍, assess the DI risk of the following scenarios in your facility:

blocks.zh: 「共用帳號」問題：無菌充填設備（灌封機、凍乾機）的 SCADA/HMI 系統是否存在多人共用同一登入帳號的情況？（Computer Access Controls 類別）
blocks.en: The "shared account" problem: Do the SCADA/HMI systems of aseptic filling equipment (filling and closing machines, lyophilizers) have multiple people sharing one login account? (Computer Access Controls category)

blocks.zh: 「事後補填」問題：操作員是否在完成操作後才事後補填批次記錄，而非即時記錄？（Contemporaneous Data Entries 類別）
blocks.en: The "after-the-fact entry" problem: Do operators fill in batch records after completing the operation rather than recording in real time? (Contemporaneous Data Entries category)

blocks.zh: 「未授權試算表」問題：是否有人使用未受管控的 Excel 試算表進行製程計算？（Computer Access Controls + Unofficial Records 類別）
blocks.en: The "unauthorized spreadsheet" problem: Does anyone use uncontrolled Excel spreadsheets for process calculations? (Computer Access Controls + Unofficial Records categories)

blocks.zh: 思考問題：表中「以鉛筆填寫批次記錄數據修改（Illegible Data Entries — batch records with data changes in pencil）」為何構成 DI 問題？鉛筆記錄的根本問題是什麼？
blocks.en: Question to consider: Why does the table entry "Illegible Data Entries - batch records with data changes in pencil" constitute a DI problem? What is the fundamental problem with pencil entries?

blocks.zh: Regulatory Guidance / 監管指引文件
blocks.en: Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: ALCOA 原則：資料完整性的基礎框架
blocks.en: The ALCOA Principles: The Foundational Framework of Data Integrity

blocks.zh: ALCOA 是資料完整性的五項核心要求，源自 40+ 年的 GxP 規範：
blocks.en: ALCOA comprises the five core requirements of data integrity, derived from more than 40 years of GxP expectations:

blocks.zh: A — Attributable（可歸因）：記錄應能識別是誰、在何時進行的
blocks.en: A - Attributable: the record should identify who performed the action and when

blocks.zh: L — Legible（清晰可讀）：記錄必須永久清晰，可被識別
blocks.en: L - Legible: the record must be permanently clear and readable

blocks.zh: C — Contemporaneous（即時記錄）：應在操作發生的當下即時記錄
blocks.en: C - Contemporaneous: the record should be made at the time the activity is performed

blocks.zh: O — Original（原始記錄）：保留原始數據，不得僅留副本
blocks.en: O - Original: the original data must be retained, not just a copy

blocks.zh: A — Accurate（準確）：記錄必須真實、完整、無誤
blocks.en: A - Accurate: the record must be truthful, complete, and error-free

blocks.zh: 後來延伸為 ALCOA+，增加：Complete（完整）、Consistent（一致）、Enduring（持久）、Available（可取用）。
blocks.en: It was later extended to ALCOA+, adding: Complete, Consistent, Enduring, and Available.

blocks.zh: MHRA 指引的特殊重要性
blocks.en: The Special Importance of the MHRA Guidance

blocks.zh: MHRA（英國藥品與健保產品管理局）2018 年發布的《GxP Data Integrity Guidance and Definitions》是業界最常引用的 DI 指引之一，原因：
blocks.en: The MHRA (UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency) "GxP Data Integrity Guidance and Definitions," issued in 2018, is one of the most frequently cited DI guidances in the industry, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 涵蓋範圍廣：適用於所有 GxP 活動（GLPs, GMPs, GCPs, GDPs）
blocks.en: Broad scope: applies to all GxP activities (GLPs, GMPs, GCPs, GDPs)

blocks.zh: 術語定義清晰：提供 Data Integrity 相關詞彙的權威定義
blocks.en: Clear terminology: provides authoritative definitions of data integrity-related terms

blocks.zh: 問答格式：以 Q&A 形式呈現，實務操作指引明確
blocks.en: Q&A format: presented as questions and answers, with clear practical guidance

blocks.zh: 兼容性強：與 FDA 和 WHO 指引高度互補
blocks.en: Strong compatibility: highly complementary to FDA and WHO guidance

blocks.zh: 比喻：「全球監管同步化」的意義
blocks.en: Analogy: What "Global Regulatory Harmonization" Means

blocks.zh: 2016–2019 年，全球主要監管機構幾乎同時發布 DI 指引，就像各國的交通法規同時更新了關於闖紅燈的罰則。
blocks.en: Between 2016 and 2019, the major global regulators issued DI guidance almost simultaneously, like countries all updating their traffic laws on the penalties for running red lights at the same time.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的意義：無論您的產品最終銷往美國、歐洲、澳洲或中國，都必須符合實質上相似的 DI 標準。這使得「建立一套全球通用的 DI 管控體系」比以往任何時候都更具必要性。
blocks.en: What this means for a CDMO: whether your products are ultimately sold in the U.S., Europe, Australia, or China, you must meet substantially similar DI standards. This makes "establishing a single, globally applicable DI control system" more necessary than ever.

blocks.zh: 您的廠區是否已將以下指引納入 SOP 體系？
blocks.en: Has your site incorporated the following guidances into its SOP system?

blocks.zh: FDA DI Q&A Guidance（2018）：針對美國市場客戶的主要參考
blocks.en: FDA DI Q&A Guidance (2018): the main reference for customers in the U.S. market

blocks.zh: MHRA GxP Data Integrity Guidance（2018）：針對歐洲市場客戶的主要參考
blocks.en: MHRA GxP Data Integrity Guidance (2018): the main reference for customers in the European market

blocks.zh: PIC/S DI Guidance：對 PIC/S 成員國（包含台灣）的管制機構有直接影響
blocks.en: PIC/S DI Guidance: directly relevant to regulators in PIC/S member countries (including Taiwan)

blocks.zh: 建議在廠區 DI SOP 的「法規依據」章節中明確列出所對應的指引版本，以便客戶稽查時可快速確認符合性。
blocks.en: It is recommended that the "regulatory basis" section of the site DI SOP clearly list the applicable guidance versions, so that compliance can be confirmed quickly during customer audits.

blocks.zh: Industry Best Practices / 產業最佳實踐
blocks.en: Industry Best Practices

blocks.zh: 產業最佳實踐文件的定位
blocks.en: The Role of Industry Best Practice Documents

blocks.zh: 監管指引（Regulatory Guidance）告訴你「必須做什麼」，產業最佳實踐（Industry Best Practices）告訴你「怎麼做到」。兩者互補：
blocks.en: Regulatory guidance tells you "what you must do," while industry best practices tell you "how to do it." The two complement each other:

blocks.zh: 法規指引：設定監管期望、定義術語
blocks.en: Regulatory guidance: sets regulatory expectations and defines terminology

blocks.zh: 產業指引：提供具體實施框架、工具、案例
blocks.en: Industry guidance: provides concrete implementation frameworks, tools, and case studies

blocks.zh: PDA TR84 本身即屬於產業最佳實踐文件，專注於製造與包裝操作的 DI 管理。
blocks.en: PDA TR84 is itself an industry best practice document, focusing on DI management in manufacturing and packaging operations.

blocks.zh: PDA TR80 與 TR84 的關係
blocks.en: The Relationship Between PDA TR80 and TR84

blocks.zh: PDA 技術報告第80號（TR80，2018）聚焦於實驗室的資料完整性管理系統。
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report No. 80 (TR80, 2018) focuses on data integrity management systems in the laboratory.

blocks.zh: PDA 技術報告第84號（TR84，2020）則延伸至製造與包裝操作，兩者形成完整的 PDA DI 體系：
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report No. 84 (TR84, 2020) extends this to manufacturing and packaging operations, and together they form a complete PDA DI framework:

blocks.zh: TR80：QC 實驗室 DI 管理
blocks.en: TR80: DI management in the QC laboratory

blocks.zh: TR84：生產與包裝 DI 管理
blocks.en: TR84: DI management in production and packaging

blocks.zh: 比喻：產業指引 = 同行的實戰心得
blocks.en: Analogy: Industry Guidance = Practical Lessons from Peers

blocks.zh: 監管指引像是政府發布的「駕駛考試規則」，產業指引則像是駕訓班老師的「考試攻略」——兩者都需要，但後者告訴你如何有效通過。
blocks.en: Regulatory guidance is like the government-issued "driving test rules," while industry guidance is like the driving instructor's "exam tips." You need both, but the latter tells you how to pass effectively.

blocks.zh: ISPE GAMP Records and Data Integrity 指引特別針對電腦化系統，對具有複雜 IT 架構的無菌充填廠（SCADA、MES、LIMS 等）尤其實用。
blocks.en: The ISPE GAMP Records and Data Integrity guide specifically addresses computerized systems and is especially useful for aseptic filling facilities with complex IT architectures (SCADA, MES, LIMS, etc.).

blocks.zh: APIC 指引對 API 供應商的特殊意義
blocks.en: What the APIC Guidance Means for API Suppliers

blocks.zh: APIC（Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Committee，原料藥委員會）的《Practical Risk-Based Guide for Managing Data Integrity》是 API 製造商的首選參考。
blocks.en: APIC's (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Committee) "Practical Risk-Based Guide for Managing Data Integrity" is the preferred reference for API manufacturers.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：如果您同時承接 API 中間體與製劑無菌充填業務，兩套指引都需納入廠區 DI 系統設計中。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: if you undertake both API intermediates and aseptic filling of drug products, both guidances need to be incorporated into the design of the site DI system.

blocks.zh: PDA Code of Conduct for Data Integrity（2016）比其他技術性指引更早發布，您認為為什麼「行為規範」是 DI 管理的起點？技術控制與文化行為在 DI 防範中各扮演什麼角色？
blocks.en: The PDA Code of Conduct for Data Integrity (2016) was published earlier than the other technical guidances. Why do you think a "code of conduct" is the starting point of DI management? What roles do technical controls and cultural behavior each play in DI prevention?

blocks.zh: 建立廠區 DI 文件體系時，建議的「指引對照矩陣」：
blocks.en: When building the site DI document system, the recommended "guidance cross-reference matrix" is:

blocks.zh: 本節總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心訊息：DI 是當代 GMP 合規的頭號議題
blocks.en: Key Message: DI Is the Top Issue in Contemporary GMP Compliance

blocks.zh: 第一節從歷史、統計、法規、產業四個維度，建立了對資料完整性（Data Integrity）監管趨勢的全面認識：
blocks.en: Section 1 has built a comprehensive understanding of data integrity (DI) regulatory trends across four dimensions: history, statistics, regulation, and industry.

blocks.zh: 歷史維度：DI 違規事件週期性爆發（1980年代仿製藥醜聞 → 2012年後全球供應鏈擴張），每次都帶來更嚴格的法規回應。
blocks.en: Historical dimension: DI violations erupt periodically (the 1980s generic drug scandal, then the global supply chain expansion after 2012), each time bringing a stricter regulatory response.

blocks.zh: 統計維度：FDA 警告信（Warning Letter）中超過 53%、EU NCR 中恰好 50% 涉及 DI——DI 是查廠缺陷的最大宗。
blocks.en: Statistical dimension: More than 53% of FDA Warning Letters and exactly 50% of EU NCRs involve DI, making DI the largest single category of inspection deficiencies.

blocks.zh: 法規維度：2016–2019 年全球八個主要監管機構同步發布 DI 指引，形成跨國一致的執法標準。
blocks.en: Regulatory dimension: Between 2016 and 2019, eight major regulators worldwide issued DI guidance in parallel, creating a consistent cross-national enforcement standard.

blocks.zh: 產業維度：PDA、ISPE、APIC 提供的最佳實踐文件是業者從「符合法規要求」轉為「建立系統性 DI 程序」的操作橋樑。
blocks.en: Industry dimension: The best practice documents from PDA, ISPE, and APIC are the operational bridge that helps firms move from "meeting regulatory requirements" to "establishing systematic DI procedures."

blocks.zh: CDMO 從業者的核心啟示
blocks.en: Key Takeaways for CDMO Practitioners

blocks.zh: DI 缺陷的根本原因同時涉及技術面（系統設計、稽核軌跡）和行為面（管理文化、員工訓練），單純強化一方無法解決問題。
blocks.en: The root causes of DI deficiencies involve both technical factors (system design, audit trail) and behavioral factors (management culture, staff training); strengthening only one side cannot solve the problem.

blocks.zh: Table 3.1.3-1🔍 的 13 類缺陷是廠區 DI 自評的最佳對照清單——每一類都應在廠內的風險評估中有對應的控制措施。
blocks.en: The 13 categories of deficiencies in Table 3.1.3-1🔍 are the best checklist for a site DI self-assessment; every category should have corresponding controls in the site risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 臺灣廠商（包括 TWi 等 CDMO）出現在 FDA WL 國家清單中，提示本地業者無法置身事外，必須以同等嚴肅的態度建立 DI 管理系統。
blocks.en: The appearance of Taiwan firms (including CDMOs such as TWi) in the FDA WL country list shows that local firms cannot stand aside and must establish DI management systems with the same level of seriousness.

blocks.zh: 稽核軌跡（Audit Trail）停用是最常被引述的電子系統 DI 缺陷，任何 GMP 電腦化系統的稽核軌跡均不得擅自關閉或修改。
blocks.en: A disabled audit trail is the most frequently cited electronic-system DI deficiency; the audit trail of any GMP computerized system must not be switched off or altered without authorization.

blocks.zh: 進入下一節的思維準備
blocks.en: Mindset for the Next Section

blocks.zh: Section 1 建立了「為什麼 DI 很重要」的宏觀背景；Section 2（Quality Risk Management Applied to Data Integrity）將進一步說明「如何系統性地評估和管理 DI 風險」。
blocks.en: Section 1 has set out the big-picture background of "why DI matters"; Section 2 (Quality Risk Management Applied to Data Integrity) will go on to explain "how to assess and manage DI risk systematically."

blocks.zh: 帶著這個問題進入下一節：在您的廠區中，哪些數據管理環節的風險最高——是紙本記錄、混合系統、還是已數位化但缺乏稽核軌跡的舊系統？
blocks.en: Carry this question into the next section: In your facility, which data management areas carry the highest risk: paper records, hybrid systems, or legacy systems that have been digitized but lack audit trails?
